newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, June 11 are expected to total $2 billion in 43 deals according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.3 billion in 19 sales, with a $540 million Puerto Rico Public Building deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the list.

On the competitive side, 24 sales totaling $748 million are scheduled. Two deals, each totaling $200 million, top the competitive calender -- one from the New Jersey Housing Commission at 1200 EDT and one Utah issue at 1230 EDT are the largest.
An additional nine sales totaling $381 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
